newsitem.title: USA: Golf Technology to show Q3, year loss.
newsitem.headline: Golf Technology to show Q3, year loss.

text.p: Golf Technology Holding Inc said Tuesday that it will report a loss for the third quarter, a profit for the fourth quarter and a loss for the year.
Golf Technology said that revenues for the first nine months of 1996 were $3.4 million, compared with $1.0 million the year before.
The company said that it is investing heavily in an aggressive marketing campaign which requries substantial financial resources.
It said that during the past three months it has added staff and increased production facilities three-fold to work off a backlog.
Financial results for previous periods were not immediately avialable.
